Anchor Necessity Boundary.novelty: ENTERPRISE SEMANTIC BOUNDARY / candidate reusable theorem interface
Anchor Necessity Boundary.statement: If two states share a residual but differ in anchor/context and some permitted future observable distinguishes them, residual-only state is incomplete.
witnesses: same residual r=1/4 at anchors 0 and 10 under x^2

Projection/Correction Duality.novelty: cross-domain synthesis, not a claim of new component algorithms
Projection/Correction Duality.statement: Projection is safe as a coarse anchor only when lost detail is irrelevant to the observable or is reintroduced through a correction channel; otherwise repeated projection accumulates bias/drift.

Residual-State Principle.novelty: GENERALIZATION/BOOKKEEPING LAW; component algorithms are prior art
Residual-State Principle.statement: Residual is a sufficient primary iteration coordinate only when future correction/observable factorizes through residual plus fixed solver/operator context; otherwise anchor/context is required.

CONTINUE_INVEST.ANCHOR_NECESSITY_BOUNDARY: Promote as a reusable semantic guard: residual-only is invalid whenever permitted future observables distinguish equal-residual states with different anchors/context.
CONTINUE_INVEST.FIELD_COORDINATE: Invest selectively where future evolution/observable factorizes through basin, phase, gap, active-set or residual coordinates and reconstruction cost is explicitly lower.
CONTINUE_INVEST.RESIDUAL_COLLAPSE: Invest in a residual-sufficiency/factorization checker and multi-level state compiler, not in rebranding rooted algorithms. Evidence spans arithmetic, quantization, summation, refinement, multigrid, projection and rasterization, but fails when residual precision/context is insufficient.

DEPRIORITIZE_OR_RETIRE.FAR_PROJECTION: Retain only as hostile/adversarial control; fails metric, rounding, dynamical and conservation objectives across tested domains.
DEPRIORITIZE_OR_RETIRE.UNCONDITIONAL_RESIDUAL_ONLY: Reject. Require a factorization/sufficiency proof or carry anchor/operator/context.
DEPRIORITIZE_OR_RETIRE.UNIFORM_ENDPOINT_RANDOM: Do not call it unbiased except at basin midpoint; retain only as a stochastic control or when 50/50 endpoints are independently part of the problem semantics.
DEPRIORITIZE_OR_RETIRE.UNIVERSAL_DOWN_OR_UP: Reject. Direction is objective-dependent rather than foundationally privileged by these external benchmarks.

driver_recommendations.NOVELTY_BOUNDARY: No tested collapse family dominates a classical reference solver on a declared resource axis. The surviving Enterprise residue is semantic/tooling: type-safe collapse selection, residual sufficiency tests, anchor-necessity counterexamples, state-accounting, and cross-domain capability compilation.

SPECIAL_MODE_ONLY.ANCHOR_PLUS_RESIDUAL: Keep as exact bookkeeping/reference decomposition and safe fallback; no resource gain without compression/factorization.
SPECIAL_MODE_ONLY.BRC_SUPPORT: Keep only for exact Boolean/result-support semantics; R026 shows semantic exactness but no scalar numerical resource advantage.
SPECIAL_MODE_ONLY.DOWN_PROJECTION: Keep for certified lower bounds, truncation, lower raster envelopes or monotone safety goals; reject as universal collapse direction.
SPECIAL_MODE_ONLY.NEAREST_PROJECTION: Use as standard metric/MSE rounding/projection baseline; no Enterprise novelty established.
SPECIAL_MODE_ONLY.UNBIASED_DISTANCE_RANDOM: Use when expectation preservation is the declared observable and variance/pathwise invariant cost is acceptable; rooted stochastic rounding.
SPECIAL_MODE_ONLY.UP_PROJECTION: Keep for certified upper bounds/conservative enclosure; reject as universal collapse direction.
